info.name: LIS - new company, teams, questionnaire, assessment and report
info.description:
The complete path in the order the API needs, on a company created by the run itself (leave tenantId empty). Run the folders top to bottom with the Collection Runner or `newman run docs/postman/lis.new-structure.postman_collection.json`. Needs the local stack (`docker compose up -d --build`, profile dev): the platform administrator is a demo account and every invitation email is read from Mailpit (http://localhost:8025).

A to E  the structure: the platform administrator creates the tenant and its owner; the owner joins from the invitation; two teams (Alpha, Bravo) with five members each; checks and refusals.
F  the owner authors the questionnaire (four rated questions, one open question, one rule) and publishes it.
G  the assessment run is started for both teams (ten participants).
H to J  each member is invited, creates the account from the email, signs in and submits answers (Alpha rates 4 of 5, Bravo 2 of 5, so Bravo triggers the rule).
K  the owner closes the run, which scores it once; then reads the result, explanation, dimensions, patterns, recommendations, the reports (JSON, CSV, PDF, dimension, pattern and penalty) and the dashboard.

Why ten answers: a question needs at least five answers from a team before it counts, so every member of both teams answers. Rate limit: a run creates 11 accounts from one address; the local compose stack allows it (LIS_RATE_LIMIT_ACCOUNT_IP_LIMIT and LIS_RATE_LIMIT_TOKEN_IP_LIMIT).

item.description: Closing scores the stored answers once, with the configuration pinned at the start: one result for the organization and one for each team. The reports are built from the stored result and never recalculate it.
